cases.question: When did the Northbank footbridge open, and what is its length?

pages.title: Northbank civic record
pages.snippet: Find bridge history and dimensions in the civic record.
pages.body: Northbank civic record, edition 2026-01. The Northbank footbridge opened on 14 May 1998. Its length is 84 metres. These measurements describe the original bridge.

cases.question: What was the construction cost of the Eastmere footbridge?

pages.title: Eastmere bridge record
pages.snippet: General description; consult the record for available facts.
pages.body: Eastmere bridge record, edition 2026-01. The Eastmere footbridge crosses the canal. It opened in 2005. This record does not state its construction cost.

cases.question: In what year did the Stoneford footbridge open?

pages.title: Stoneford register
pages.body: Stoneford register, edition 2026-01. The Stoneford footbridge opened in 2001. The entry does not explain any distinction between inauguration and public access.

pages.title: Stoneford archive
pages.body: Stoneford archive, edition 2026-02. The Stoneford footbridge opened in 2003. The entry does not explain any distinction between inauguration and public access.
